user.wizard.key.title: Bring your own Flickr API key
user.wizard.key.lead: XFlickr has no key of its own. Create one on Flickr, then paste the key and secret. They are stored encrypted and used only for your crawl.
user.wizard.key.why.title: Why your own key?
user.wizard.key.why.text: Flickr gives every key 3,600 calls per hour. With your own key your crawl uses your own quota and never waits behind other people.
user.wizard.key.error.key-format: The key should be 32 characters, 0-9 and a-f. Copy it again from Flickr's app page.
user.wizard.key.error.secret-format: The secret should be 16 characters, 0-9 and a-f.
user.wizard.key.error.invalid: Flickr rejected this key. Check the key and secret on your Flickr app page.
user.wizard.key.error.duplicate: This key is already in your account.
user.wizard.key.error.network: We could not reach Flickr. Your input is kept. Try again.
user.wizard.key.error.no-node: No healthy node can take a new key right now. Try again in a few minutes.
user.wizard.connect.title: Connect your Flickr account
user.wizard.connect.lead: XFlickr asks Flickr for read permission. You approve it on Flickr; XFlickr never sees your password.
user.wizard.connect.perm.title: XFlickr would like to
user.wizard.connect.perm.read: Read your contacts, photos, favorites and albums
user.wizard.connect.perm.private: Read non-public photos you can see (kept private to you)
user.wizard.connect.perm.cannot: It cannot upload, edit or delete anything.
user.wizard.connect.leave-warning: You will leave XFlickr to approve on Flickr.
user.wizard.connect.denied: You declined on Flickr. Nothing was connected. Try again when ready.
